transfer.title: Import and export
transfer.intro: Export an HTML file from your browser bookmark manager, then import it into Flare. Files are processed by your local Flare server without visiting bookmarked websites.
transfer.migration_hint: Import and export each collection separately. Export both YAML files for a complete migration; accounts, passwords and system settings are excluded.
transfer.export_hint: HTML includes names, links and categories, excluding icons, descriptions, private flags and display settings. Unsafe old links are omitted. YAML preserves all bookmark fields.
transfer.flatten: Place everything in the target category
transfer.strip_root: Ignore the outermost folder (such as Bookmarks Bar)
transfer.allow_other: Allow relative URLs and other supported protocols
transfer.import_hint: Folder paths are preserved using / between levels; home applications have no categories. Duplicates are matched by URL within the target category. Updates preserve existing icons, descriptions and private flags when absent from the source. UTF-8 files only; limits: 8 MiB, 20,000 entries, 32 folder levels.
transfer.preview_hint: Previews expire after 15 minutes. Existing data is unchanged until confirmation. The selected collection is backed up before import. Preview again if existing bookmarks change.
